name: @rentnerkev/select
description: Accessible, searchable React select with single and multiple selection support.
author: RentnerKev

scripts.build: bun -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc --project tsconfig.type-tests.json && bun run typecheck:playground && bun run typecheck:automation
scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings src scripts playground/src playground/vite.config.ts playwright.config.ts .github/scripts
scripts.lint:fix: oxlint --fix --deny-warnings src scripts playground/src playground/vite.config.ts playwright.config.ts .github/scripts
scripts.format: oxfmt src scripts playground/src .github/scripts docs README.md package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.type-tests.json playground/tsconfig.json playground/package.json playground/vite.config.ts playwright.config.ts .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check src scripts playground/src .github/scripts docs README.md package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.type-tests.json playground/tsconfig.json playground/package.json playground/vite.config.ts playwright.config.ts .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json
scripts.verify: bun run playground:install && bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run test && bun run build && bun run pack:check && bun run pack:consumer && bun run e2e
